Credit Controller (3-Month Fixed-Term Contract)

Location: Cannock, Staffordshire (5 days per week onsite)
Salary: £30,000 equivalent pro rata
Contract: 3-Month Fixed-Term Contract
Start Date: Immediate Start Available

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Credit Controller to join a busy finance team on a 3-month fixed-term contract. This is an excellent opportunity for a driven and organised individual who can hit the ground running and support the business in maintaining strong cash flow and reducing aged debt.

Based onsite in Cannock five days per week, you will play a key role in managing customer accounts, ensuring timely collections, and building effective relationships with internal stakeholders and external clients.

Key Responsibilities
- Proactively manage and collect outstanding debt across a portfolio of customer accounts.
- Contact customers by telephone and email to secure prompt payment.
- Investigate and resolve invoice queries and payment disputes efficiently.
- Produce and review aged debt reports, highlighting high-risk accounts.
- Allocate incoming payments and reconcile customer accounts.
- Maintain accurate records of all collection activity and customer communications.
- Work closely with sales, customer service, and finance teams to resolve issues impacting payment.
- Support month-end processes and reporting requirements.
- Ensure adherence to company credit control policies and procedures.

About You
- Previous experience in a Credit Controller, Accounts Receivable, or Collections position.
- Proven ability to manage and reduce aged debt.
- Strong communication and negotiation skills.
- Confident working with high volumes of customer accounts.
- Good attention to detail and accurate record-keeping skills.
- Proficient in Microsoft Excel and finance systems.
- Ability to work independently and prioritise workload effectively.
- Available to start immediately or at short notice.

Benefits
- Immediate start opportunity.
- Competitive salary of £30,000 equivalent pro rata.
- Friendly and supportive team environment.
- Valuable experience within a fast-paced finance function.
- Free onsite parking.

Apply Now

If you are an experienced Credit Controller available for an immediate start and looking for your next contract opportunity in Cannock, we would love to hear from you.

title: Part Time Credit Controller
description:
Astute Recruitment are working with an established business with offices in Tamworth and Ashby-de-la-Zouch to recruit an experienced Credit Controller on a permanent, part-time basis. This is an opportunity for a seasoned Credit Controller to take full ownership of the credit control function, managing the aged debt position and driving outstanding payments forward.

The Role Will Involve:
- Taking full ownership of the credit control function and aged debt
- Proactively chasing outstanding payments by phone and email
- Producing and managing aged debt reports
- Manipulating and analysing financial data using Excel, including Pivot Tables
- Monitoring customer accounts and prioritising collection activity
- Investigating and resolving account and invoice queries
- Allocating payments and maintaining accurate customer account records
- Identifying overdue or potentially problematic accounts and taking appropriate action
- Providing updates on the aged debt position and collection activity
- Working with internal teams to resolve queries and minimise outstanding debt
- Supporting improvements to credit control processes and procedures
- Carrying out wider finance duties where required

The Ideal Candidate:
- Experienced Credit Controller with a strong track record in credit control and debt recovery
- Confident taking ownership of a credit control function and working autonomously
- Strong Excel skills, including Pivot Tables and manipulating financial data
- Comfortable producing and analysing aged debt reports
- Confident communicator with a professional and persistent approach to debt collection
- Strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills
- Able to investigate issues and resolve customer account queries effectively
- Sage 200 experience would be highly advantageous, but is not essential
- Proactive, commercially minded and comfortable taking responsibility

Benefits & Hours:
- Salary: Up to 36,000 FTE depending on experience
- Permanent, part-time position - 25.5 hours per week
- Flexible start and finish times
- Based in either Tamworth or Ashby-de-la-Zouch
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, pro rata

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Payroll administrator

36 hours per week Monday - Friday

Temporary Ongoing

Pay rate £17.24 p/h

Location: Stafford ST18

IMMEDIATE START

Payroll administrator

Job Purpose

To support the accurate and timely processing of payroll for employees, ensuring all pay, deductions, and statutory payments are administered correctly and in line with company policies and current legislation.

This is a great opportunity for someone with previous payroll or finance administration experience.

Key Responsibilities
- Process weekly and/or monthly payrolls accurately and within deadlines.
- Maintain employee payroll records and ensure all information is up to date.
- Calculate and process overtime, bonuses, commissions, holiday pay, statutory payments, and deductions.
- Ensure compliance with HMRC regulations and payroll legislation.
- Process starters, leavers, and employee changes, including salary amendments and pension enrolments.
- Assist with pension administration and auto-enrolment requirements.
- Respond to payroll-related queries from employees and managers in a professional and timely manner.
- Reconcile payroll reports and identify any discrepancies.
- Prepare payroll reports for management and finance teams as required.
- Maintain confidentiality of payroll and employee information at all times.
- Support payroll audits and provide relevant documentation when requested.
- Liaise with HR, Finance, and external payroll providers where necessary.

Skills & Experience

Essential:
- Previous experience in a payroll administration or payroll assistant role.
- Good understanding of payroll processes and statutory payments.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Excellent numerical and data entry skills.
- Proficient in Microsoft Excel and payroll systems.
- Strong communication and organisational skills.
- Ability to manage confidential information with discretion.

Desirable:
- Payroll or finance-related qualification.
- Experience using payroll software such as Sage Payroll, Iris, ADP, or similar.
- Understanding of pensions and auto-enrolment legislation.

title: Payroll and Benefits Officer
company: Four Squared Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Payroll and Benefits Officer (Part time - 24 hours per week)
Staffordshire £30-32 K (Pro Rata) Permanent
We re looking for an experienced payroll professional to take ownership of a varied, standalone payroll position based in Staffordshire.
This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys getting stuck into the detail. The payroll currently involves a mixture of manual processes, so you ll need to be comfortable working this way whilst also supporting the business as it continues to move towards more digital ways of working.
The role will include:
- Managing payroll for up to 250 employees
- Processing a mixture of lunar and monthly payrolls
- Managing different pay types including hourly, minimum wage and salaried employees
- Supporting a separate pensioner payroll linked to a final salary scheme
- Processing payroll using Sage 50 Payroll
- Managing pensions, including auto-enrolment and annual pension audits
- Working with pension providers including Aviva and The People s Pension
- Managing timesheets and ensuring payroll is processed accurately and on time
- Helping to improve and digitalise existing payroll processes

What we re looking for!
- You ll be an experienced payroll professional who is confident managing a busy and occasionally complex payroll.
- Previous experience using Sage 50 Payroll is important, and exposure to Sage HR would be beneficial.
- You ll also be comfortable working with manual processes, rather than expecting everything to be fully automated from day one.
- Experience of payrolls involving different rates, pay structures or employee groups would be particularly useful.

The role is part time, and we are looking for the successful candidate to work Mondays and Thursdays in office, with some flexibility around the working pattern.
If you re looking for a part-time payroll role where you can genuinely take ownership and help shape how the function works moving forward, this could be a really good fit.
